identity.name: Carrera Glassbox
identity.one_liner: The 2023 Carrera Glassbox — the 1963 Heuer Carrera reissue with the domed sapphire crystal and the in-house Heuer 02 caliber. The most-cited modern TAG Heuer sport chronograph.

provenance_events.description: TAG Heuer launches the Carrera Date Glassbox (CBS2210) at Watches and Wonders 2023 — a 39mm case with a domed sapphire "glassbox" crystal over the dial, reissuing a 1970s Carrera family design.

narrative.story: The Carrera Glassbox is the 2023 release that reissued the 1963 Heuer Carrera with a domed sapphire crystal (the "Glassbox" name) and the modern in-house Heuer 02 caliber. The 39mm case, the glassbox crystal, and the column-wheel chronograph are the 2023 specification. The Carrera Glassbox is the most-cited modern TAG Heuer and the watch a collector cites when they want a vintage-modern chronograph with a domed crystal and an in-house caliber.
narrative.collector_notes: The Heuer 02 caliber has a column wheel and a vertical clutch, with an 80-hour reserve. The glassbox crystal arches over the bezel-less dial opening, a design reference to the 1963 Heuer Carrera Dato 45.
